telos.statement: Determine which system-design distinctions are worth internalizing into the Architecture Decision Discriminator because they materially improve live architecture decisions without turning the capability into a pattern encyclopedia or premature agent.
telos.success_condition: Produce a bounded architecture-decision research lane that separates workload pressure, required system properties, measured bottlenecks, candidate mechanisms, tradeoffs/counterindications, migration cost and operational burden; identify only adaptations that can be tested for unique decision delta on historical and holdout cases.

current_state.summary: Architecture Decision Discriminator v0 exists as CANDIDATE_CAPABILITY_NOT_AGENT. It already names boundaries, constraints, invariants, dependencies, state authority, failure domains, change propagation, migration, reversibility and tradeoff lineage. R&D v0.2 owns resource↔telos calibration; Neta owns signal/interpretation/mechanism discrimination. The ByteByteGo video '8 Most Important System Design Concepts You Should Know' is the initiating external signal, not ground truth.
known_constraints: Do not promote system-design pattern names into doctrine.
Do not equate pattern coverage with architecture competence.
Prefer explicit decision discriminators over a broad knowledge dump.
Use primary/authoritative sources to adjudicate claims when possible; videos may generate hypotheses.
Do not adapt the canonical Architecture Decision Discriminator until historical-case decision delta survives comparison.
Do not build an Architecture Agent merely because a technical domain is broad.

decision_blocked.statement: Should the Architecture Decision Discriminator be adapted with explicit workload/SLO/bottleneck/counterindication/operational-burden objects, and which system-design topics deserve deeper research because they can change that decision?
decision_blocked.current_default: Keep Architecture Decision Discriminator v0 unchanged; treat system-design knowledge as borrowed scaffold knowledge until a named missing discriminator shows material decision delta.
decision_blocked.reversal_condition: Across historical architecture cases, one or more explicit candidate objects repeatedly change the bounded architecture decision, migration/reversal condition, or authority handoff more cheaply/reliably than the current v0 contract plus generic scaffold reasoning.

signals: The initiating video maps recurring scaling/reliability pressures to mechanisms such as caching, asynchronous processing, replication/load balancing, CDN/edge, storage choices, observability, indexing and sharding.

Primary architecture/SRE frameworks emphasize desired system properties, user-relevant objectives, business requirements, tradeoffs, failure modes and operational evolution rather than pattern-count completeness.

Architecture Decision Discriminator v0 covers many structural consequences but does not make workload profile, SLO/quality-attribute target, measured bottleneck evidence, mechanism counterindications, or operational burden explicit first-class objects.
